info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Employee By Param2-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows for the modification of specific expense claims associated with an employee. By using the employee ID and a unique parameter, clients can update relevant details of expense claims to ensure accuracy and compliance. Typical consumers of this API include HR managers and finance teams who need to manage and correct employee expense submissions. This operation is essential for maintaining up-to-date financial records within the organization.

put.summary: Update Specific Expense Claim for Employee
put.description: This operation allows you to update a specific expense claim associated with an employee identified by the employee ID. Ensure that all required fields are present in the request body to successfully perform the update.

requestBody.description: Updates the expense claim with the specified ID for the employee. The request body must conform to the defined schema to ensure proper validation and processing of the expense claim data.
